subject: Fine Art
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of some advanced theories and principles of Fine Art
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of forms of Fine Art in East and West Africa
entries.learning_activity: (a) Analyse forms of sculpture and animation in East and West African societies
teaching_learning_activities: Scenario: Provide a scenario that shows various Fine Arts works to analyse forms of sculpture and animation in East and West African societies)
Jigsaw: Guide Students to analyse tools, materials and social functions of sculpture and animation in East and West African societies
Library search: Assign students in groups to search information from various sources about the management of sculpture and animation in East and West African societies
entries.assessment: Forms of sculpture and animation in East and West African societies are well analysed
entries.references: TIE, Fine Art for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of some advanced theories and principles of Fine Art
entries.specific_competence: 1.2 Demonstrate an understanding of basic principles of curating works of Fine Art
entries.learning_activity: (a) Describe the basic principles of curating sculpture and animation artworks
teaching_learning_activities: Scenario: Use a scenario to guide students describe the basic principles of curating sculpture and animation
Field trip: Students to visit nearby artists and art studios to observe the principles of curating sculpture and animation artworks
Discussion: Guide Students to discuss and present what has been learnt from the field
entries.assessment: The basic principles of curating sculptures and animations are well described
entries.references: TIE, Fine Art for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.specific_competence: 2.1 Create still and video images
entries.learning_activity: (a) Create and animate illustrations using computer software
teaching_learning_activities: Think-ink- pair-share: Guide students to discuss the process of Creating and animating illustrations using computer software
Hands-on activities: Guide students in small groups to employ basic principles to create and animate illustrations using computer software
Exhibition: Guide students to display the illustrations for class discussion
entries.assessment: Illustrations using computer software are well created and animated
resources: computer software (Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, GIMP and Ink-scape)
entries.references: TIE, Fine Art for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
